bagPolicy.summary: Bags and backpacks larger than DIN A4 are not permitted; bags may be searched at the entrances.
prohibited: Bags and backpacks larger than A4
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There are roughly 2,300 parking spaces within 200 metres of the arena, including its nearby garage and car park.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: There is no designated taxi rank. Taxis stop near the arena on Theodorstraße.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drink kiosks in the foyers open when doors open and stay open until the event ends. Stalls accept cash, debit and credit cards, and mobile pay, and there is no cash machine on site.

accessibility.summary: The venue is accessible, but the upper tier isn't suitable for guests with disabilities or reduced mobility. Wheelchair and other accessible tickets are sold by the event organizer, not the venue, and usually include a seat for one companion. Accessible parking is on the ground floor of the P1 car park.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general will-call pickup procedure for concerts; consult the event instructions.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Allow extra time for ticket and bag checks at arena entrances; concert door times appear on the individual event page.
